# Front differential removal for locking differentials

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Drive up ramps, remove skid plates and bushings, then swap stock gears with Lokka units inside the front differential. [t2125]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use a spray bottle of water nearby in case PB Blaster flares up when heated. [t2125]
- [Partial] If the front two bushings are bolted, consider unboltting the entire front cross member instead to allow straight lifting later. [t2125]
- [Partial] Avoid bending the sleeve inwards as it tends to bind; instead, cut one slot and push straight down around the edges. [t2125]
- [Partial] If grinding is needed, remove the nut from the gear first to avoid accidentally grinding down the actual axle gear teeth. [t2125]
- Watch for tapered sections on normal punches that might wedge in; use a blunt drill bit end if the standard punch is too wide. [t2125]
